source: NASA PDS Geosciences Node - LRO LOLA GDR polar (LOLA science team)
crs: Polar stereographic, centre 90S/0E, sphere R=1737.4 km (IAU Moon, planetocentric, east-positive)
description: Each sample represents height relative to a reference radius (OFFSET) and is generated using preliminary LOLA data produced by the LOLA team.
processing: Read at native resolution; DN*SCALING_FACTOR+OFFSET applied; nodata/ISIS special pixels -> NaN; bilinear sampling only where all 4 neighbours valid. Raw file untouched.
coordinate_transformation: Site lat/lon (planetocentric, east-positive) -> south polar stereographic x=rho*sin(lon), y=rho*cos(lon), rho=2R tan((90+lat)/2); local east/north rotated per site.
known_limitations: Gridded from LOLA tracks; interpolated cells between tracks; ~80 m posting cannot resolve boulders/small craters. Heights relative to 1737.4 km sphere.

source: LOLA illumination EXTRAS (MIT imbrium mirror); served by NASA Moon Trek as AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608_SP (WMTS tiles)
crs: Polar stereographic, centre 90S/0E, sphere R=1737.4 km (IAU Moon, planetocentric, east-positive)
units: fraction of time Sun visible (0-1), 18.6-yr average
description: Each sample is a binary value that indicates whether that location is in permanent shadow (DN=0, scaling to 0) or its average solar disc visibility (DN up to 25000, scaling to 1).
processing: Read at native resolution; DN*SCALING_FACTOR+OFFSET applied; nodata/ISIS special pixels -> NaN; bilinear sampling only where all 4 neighbours valid. Raw file untouched.
coordinate_transformation: Site lat/lon (planetocentric, east-positive) -> south polar stereographic x=rho*sin(lon), y=rho*cos(lon), rho=2R tan((90+lat)/2); local east/north rotated per site.
known_limitations: 18.6-yr average fraction of solar disc visible (2016 release, DEM-derived, not observed). Coverage 85S-pole full, partial to ~82.9S. Linear DEM artifacts noted by producers. Not supported by PDS/LOLA team (EXTRAS).

source: ASU LROC PDS (QuickMap / Moon Trek layer WAC_POLE_ILL_PCT_SOUTH_100M)
crs: Polar stereographic, centre 90S/0E, sphere R=1737.4 km (IAU Moon, planetocentric, east-positive)
description: WAC polar illumination map (88 to 90 deg South) derived from repeat observations acquired over one year (see [SPEYERERETAL2013]). This map indicates the percentage (PCT) of observations where the surface was illuminated in the south polar region and is sampled at 100 m/pixel in a polar stereographic projection centered at 90.0 S, 0.0 E. This map does not take into account the non-linear temporal sampling between observations.
processing: Read at native resolution; DN*SCALING_FACTOR+OFFSET applied; nodata/ISIS special pixels -> NaN; bilinear sampling only where all 4 neighbours valid. Raw file untouched.
coordinate_transformation: Site lat/lon (planetocentric, east-positive) -> south polar stereographic x=rho*sin(lon), y=rho*cos(lon), rho=2R tan((90+lat)/2); local east/north rotated per site.
known_limitations: Percentage of WAC images (one lunar year, 2010-2011) in which pixel was lit; does not correct non-linear temporal sampling; coverage 88S-90S only.
